about: mutate-spec runs a spec's control once, then each of its mutants at once in a copy of its own, and a copy of a git worktree gets an index and HEAD of its own. Run: mutate-on-target.py TREE mutate-spec.py tests/test_mutate_on_target.py tests/mutants/jpt-per-mutant-on-mutate-spec.json

mutants.name: every mutant run repeats the control
mutants.target: one spec: the control ran once, not once per mutant

mutants.name: one run at a time, whatever --jobs says
mutants.target: one spec: its three mutants ran at once, each saw all three

mutants.name: a worktree copy keeps the .git file, sharing ROOT's index and branch HEAD
mutants.target: a worktree ROOT: every mutant killed on target, each copy's git as ROOT's, detached

mutants.name: the copy's HEAD stays on ROOT's branch
mutants.target: a worktree ROOT: every mutant killed on target, each copy's git as ROOT's, detached

mutants.name: the copy starts with an empty index
mutants.target: a worktree ROOT: every mutant killed on target, each copy's git as ROOT's, detached

mutants.name: the copy's gitdir is left in the repository
mutants.target: a worktree ROOT: no copy's gitdir left in the repository

mutants.name: the mutants' output is left out of the spec's output file
mutants.target: one spec: the output file holds the control and every mutant, in spec order
